market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: The 14% implied probability for Marco Rubio to win the 2028 presidency is far too high given the early stage of the cycle. Rubio is not a sitting president or vice president, and the Republican primary field will be extremely crowded. Historical base rates suggest individual senators this far out have single-digit percentage chances.
evidence_points: Rubio is a senator, not an incumbent or VP—historically such candidates have very low odds four years out.
The 2028 election is highly uncertain, with many potential candidates from both parties; early frontrunners rarely exceed 10% until the cycle clarifies.
Rubio's prior primary run in 2016 was unsuccessful, and his national profile has not markedly improved to justify a 14% chance.
sources_consulted: Base-rate analysis of presidential candidacy success
